description:
US Citizens only

Hi Friends,
Hope you are doing great,

I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP.

Position: Salesforce Developer
Local candidates highly preferred
Phone + face-face interviews for locals
Duration: 6 months to possible extension 

Salesforce Developer Role 
BS/BA in related field (Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Business Mgmt preferred) 
Minimum of three (3) years of professional experience 
Minimum of two (2) years of direct experience with Salesforce.com products and Force.com platform 
Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification with multiple Salesforce implementations / staff positions in the Salesforce Administrator role  
Demonstrated experience managing users, data, and security in a Salesforce org with 1,000+ users 
Demonstrated experience with configuring Sales Cloud or Service Cloud features 
Demonstrated experience designing advanced Salesforce reports, dashboards, list views and business process automation 
Proven experience managing system changes without interruption to the user 
Salesforce-certified Service or Sales Consultant 
Experience with Agile development methodologies 
Demonstrates some understanding of VisualForce, HTML, Javascript and CSS Using and configuring the advanced administration capabilities of Salesforce 
Demonstrated experience with set-up or configuration of Salesforce Knowledge 
Demonstrated experience maintaining, enhancing and creating workflows, functions and configurations within the Salesforce.com environment 
Experience managing new releases of Salesforce.com and efficiently implementing new features



 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
